# create_maa_regiment.size = (界面规模×100)÷stack；预览/实际士兵 ≈ 界面规模×100
# 生成兵种在玩家 var:skonester_sand_maa_pick 上分支，避免复制 flag 到目标后匹配失败

skonester_sand_compute_regiment_size_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_variable = skonester_sand_staged_scale
      has_variable = skonester_sand_staged_stack
      var:skonester_sand_staged_scale >= 1
      var:skonester_sand_staged_stack >= 1
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = skonester_sand_spawn_actual_men
      value = {
        value = var:skonester_sand_staged_scale
        multiply = var:skonester_sand_staged_stack
      }
    }
  }
}

# size 必须为字面量；与界面 skonester_sand_maa_scale（1–100）一致
skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_variable = skonester_sand_staged_scale
      var:skonester_sand_staged_scale >= 1
    }
    if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_sand_staged_scale = 1 }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        size = 1
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_sand_staged_scale = 2 }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        size = 2
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_sand_staged_scale = 3 }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        size = 3
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_sand_staged_scale = 4 }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        size = 4
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { var:skonester_sand_staged_scale = 5 }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no

      }

skonester_sand_spawn_from_player_pick_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      exists = scope:skonester_sand_spawn_tgt
      exists = scope:skonester_sand_player
      scope:skonester_sand_player = { has_variable = skonester_sand_maa_pick }
      scope:skonester_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        has_variable = skonester_sand_staged_scale
        var:skonester_sand_staged_scale >= 1
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        scope:skonester_sand_player = { var:skonester_sand_maa_pick = flag:light_footmen }
      }
      scope:skonester_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = { TYPE = light_footmen }
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        scope:skonester_sand_player = { var:skonester_sand_maa_pick = flag:armored_footmen }
      }
      scope:skonester_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = { TYPE = armored_footmen }
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        scope:skonester_sand_player = { var:skonester_sand_maa_pick = flag:pikemen_unit }
      }
      scope:skonester_sand_spawn_tgt = {
        skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = { TYPE = pikemen_unit }
      }
    }
